name: benchmark_CoViP_captioning
description: A benchmark for image captioning that evaluates models' ability to produce accurate, descriptive captions for domain-specific images. It measures fluency and correctness of generated captions against human references across a standardized test set. Designed to assess multimodal models on both semantic fidelity and natural language quality.
evaluation_method: automatic captioning metrics such as BLEU, CIDEr, and ROUGE (often a combination)
reputation: A domain-focused captioning benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers working on clinical and specialized image captioning.
